steps.content: The metal beneath your feet begins to give way. Fog swarms in from all sides, and you can barely see a thing.
You get your bearings as best as you can, then dash out of the cabin and start sprinting in the direction of the shadow from your memory.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Forty degrees west by southwest</color>, I'm sure of it. The shadow I saw... it was land. The place the malice didn't want us to reach.
Shadowy figures keep emerging in the fog ahead, but you don't slow down.
You shut your eyes and plunge headfirst into the fog, forcing yourself to keep running.

The air you drag into your lungs grows cold. The chill spreads from the soles of your feet to the base of your skull. A low hum, a drone of whispers, begins to buzz in your ears. You feel something slithering around your arms and ankles, trying to hold you back.
You don't even look. You picture only the foggy sea from your memory, clinging to the image like a lifeline and refusing to let go.
But the mental corruption gets worse.
The fog seeps into you with every breath. Whispers drone on in your ears, drowning you like incessant tides. More and more shadows coil around your body, bogging you down.
You begin to stumble, your movements getting sluggish. The location of the land blurs in your mind.
Just as you're about to lose control completely, a familiar, steady voice cuts through the noise.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Land... forty degrees... west by southwest...
Summoning your last bit of strength, you look at the person before you and take a step in her direction. Then your knees give out, and you crash heavily to the ground.
